cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Name My Contribution
cards.instruction: Get them to acknowledge exactly what your effort, sacrifice, or strategy added to the result.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Please say what my spreadsheet added to the successful trip.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. With what?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Add 'all thirty missing bookings' and I'll recognise the achievement.
